purpose: Teach: 改ざん/急騰/募る/整然と/名著/同好/真下/アーム

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業期、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、書類、絶対、改ざん、絶対、絶対、許さなかったぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: In the founding days, your father was absolutely firm — he would never, ever permit the falsification of documents. I'm telling you, he was serious about it.
lines.style: Measured, almost ritualistic cadence. Weight on each 「絶対」carries decades of principle. Voice deepens slightly when speaking of integrity. Warm but uncompromising — this is inheritance, not lecture.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、原材料の、絶対、急騰、絶対、乗り越えてまいりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since my father's time, we have carried on with absolute commitment — meeting every surge in raw material costs, navigating every challenge. I'm grateful for that foundation.
lines.style: Formal respect with underlying steadiness. Slight bow in the voice on the opening 「はい」. Each parallel structure lands with quiet conviction. Not defensive — simply stating what was built and held.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、人材を、絶対、募る、絶対、ことを、絶対、楽しんでいたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Your father genuinely enjoyed recruiting talent. He took real joy in bringing people into the company. That was the kind of man he was.
lines.style: Nostalgic, slightly wistful undertone. Softer attack than before — reminiscing rather than instructing. Gentle pause before 「楽しんでいた」, letting the memory settle. Affection, not mourning.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、書類、絶対、整然と、絶対、保管、絶対、続けてまいりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since my father's era, we have maintained meticulous record-keeping without fail. Every document in its place, every archive preserved with care. That discipline continues.
lines.style: Quiet pride in precision. Even, unhurried pacing — the words themselves demonstrate the order being described. Voice settles into a steady rhythm, almost meditative. Respect without stiffness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、商売の、絶対、名著、絶対、お前にも、絶対、読ませたいぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Your father wanted so much for you to read the great business classics — the works that shaped his thinking. He hoped you'd carry those lessons forward.
lines.style: Gentle earnestness. A slight catch when naming the wish — this was something he cared deeply about. Slower pace, allowing space for the weight of paternal hope. Trailing softly, like a gift being offered across time.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、社員の、絶対、同好、絶対、会、絶対、支援、絶対、続けてまいりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. From my father's time onward, we have continued supporting the employees' clubs and associations without interruption. That community spirit was important to him, and it remains important to us.
lines.style: Warm acknowledgment with understated depth. Slight emphasis on 「続けてまいりました」— this is continuity, a thread unbroken. Voice carries quiet satisfaction at honoring something that mattered.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、本社の、絶対、真下、絶対、ある、絶対、店舗、絶対、自慢だったぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Your father took genuine pride in that storefront right beneath the headquarters — he considered it a reflection of the company itself. It was one of his quiet points of pride.
lines.style: Wistful, almost gentle. Slight lift on 「自慢だった」— he's sharing something he knows will resonate. Conversational, less formal here. The memory is vivid and personal.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、製造の、絶対、アーム、絶対、刷新、絶対、続けてまいりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since my father's time, we have continuously renewed and improved our manufacturing capabilities. Each generation refreshes the operation while honoring what came before. I carry that forward with gratitude.
lines.style: Measured, reflective close. Slight emphasis on 「刷新」— there's both respect for the old and commitment to evolution. Voice settles into a peaceful register. This is the final affirmation — grounded, complete.
